title: Declare customer-auth capacity in Git (replace the out-of-band 200m CPU limit)
description: Aiden for SRE: customer-auth is CPU-throttled by a 200m CPU limit set with kubectl, outside Git; Argo CD still shows Synced because Git never declared customer-auth's resources. Fix it the governed way: InfraOps declares the capacity in Git (requests 100m CPU / 128Mi, limits 1 CPU / 384Mi), the capacity policy gate (CAP-001/002/003) checks the PR, and Argo CD applies it, replacing the out-of-band limit. No hand edits to the cluster. Rollback: revert the PR.

steps.text: InfraOps: read the drift and policy report for customer-auth (live CPU limit 200m set by kubectl-patch, not in Git; CAP-001/002/003). InfraOps scan: https://github.com/srclos-net/martian-bank-demo/tree/main/deploy/infraops · policy: https://github.com/srclos-net/martian-bank-demo/blob/main/policy/capacity.rego

InfraOps: open the reconcile PR declaring customer-auth capacity in Git (requests 100m/128Mi, limits 1 CPU/384Mi). InfraOps PRs: https://github.com/srclos-net/martian-bank-demo/pulls?q=is%3Apr+head%3Ainfraops%2F

DevOps: merge the PR after the capacity policy gate passes; Argo CD syncs customer-auth from Git. Policy gate runs: https://github.com/srclos-net/martian-bank-demo/actions · Argo CD: https://argocd.stackgen.run/applications/argocd/martian-bank

Aiden for SRE: login p95 under 1.5 s, CPU throttling under 25 %, customer-auth capacity owned by Git, login alert resolved. Booth dashboard: https://stephgen-medussa.observe.devopsnow.cloud/d/martian-bank-booth?orgId=6
